texts.preamble: Mohd. Tabrej And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 16 December, 2023 Author: Manju Rani Chauhan Bench: Manju Rani Chauhan High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238629 Court No. - 6 Case :- Writ - C No. - 34094 of 2023 Petitioner :- Mohd. Tabrej And 2 Others Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Rahul Chaudhary
texts.facts: A sample was taken and sent for analysis, wherein as per the analysis report, notice was given to the petitioner to which he submitted a reply. In the proceedings as initiated against the petitioners by a complaint filed under Section26(2)(ii)/51 of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006, an order was passed on 20.07.2023 by the Additional District Magistrate (Administration), District-Bijnor without considering the reply of the petitioner as submitted to the notice on the complaint so filed, imposing penalty, individually on the petitioners. Hence, this petition has been filed by the petitioners.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that reply of the petitioner has not been considered and without assigning any reason for imposing such a penalty, the initial order was passed and the stay application has been allowed to the extent of directing the petitioners to deposit 50% of the amount imposed as penalty within a period of one month. He further submits that a surprise inspection was conducted without giving proper notice as required under law within stipulated period and without considering the reply of the petitioner, the initial order was passed and the stay application has not been considered keeping the aforesaid facts in mind. Thus, the order imposing penalty of 50% is illegal and unjustified. He further requests that a direction may be issued to the competent authority to decide the appeal, within stipulated period and till then no recovery may be made from him. Learned
